caption: The drawing consists of several black line illustrations on a yellowed, off-white background. In the center, there is a large outline of a fish viewed from the side, oriented horizontally with its head to the left and a distinctly notched tail to the right. Inside the fish shape, there are two additional elements: near the head, there is a vertically-oriented dashed rectangle with a solid semicircle at its top, and near the tail there is a dashed square with a solid circle in its center. Above the fish shape are two vertical cylinder-like shapes, each resting on a horizontal line that appears cross-hatched; one cylinder is closer to the left edge, the other closer to the right edge, both with solid tops and bottoms. To the right of the fish’s tail, there is a sectional view through a curved component, drawn in profile, with straight and curved segments, and cross-hatching to indicate a cut surface. The bottom center of the drawing contains the text “- Full size -” handwritten in small print, indicating the scale of the depicted parts. The composition features technical drawing conventions like dashed lines, section lines, and simplified outlines, and is monochromatic, consisting solely of black ink on a light background.
title: Pa. German Axe Socket
